description: A collection of projects I've worked on, showcasing mobile development, AI integration, and innovative solutions.

projects.title: HMUH AI
projects.description: HMUH-AI is an innovative healthcare application developed by Hanoi Medical University Hospital and BSM Labs, applying artificial intelligence technology to provide comprehensive support to patients.
features: Developed AI-powered health features (consultation, meal suggestions, image-based food analysis) via REST APIs
Developed interactive learning modules on health topics, enhancing user engagement through dynamic content and structured educational flows
Integrated wearable SDK (Hband) using platform channels
Captured real-time wearable data, synchronized with backend APIs, and rendered server-processed metrics through interactive charts.
Built streaming chatbot using SSE with Markdown rendering for rich conversation UI.
Implemented real-time doctor chat using Socket.IO with Bloc state management
Integrated FCM push notifications with background handling for reliable health alerts and updates.

projects.title: Truc Tam
projects.description: Trực Tâm is a community-focused learning and personal development app that empowers users with educational content, self-growth resources, and opportunities to connect with a sincere learning network
features: Developed core social networking features including authentication, user profiles, content feeds, likes, comments, and dynamic content rendering
Implemented audio playback functionality with background support, allowing continuous listening when the app is minimized
Built real-time interaction features and synchronized data with backend APIs
Implemented push notifications for new posts, interactions, and community updates
Implemented real-time 1-1 and group chat using Socket.IO with efficient state synchronization and message streaming
Optimized UI performance and state handling for smooth scrolling and dynamic content rendering

projects.title: VDI AI DX
projects.description: An internal AI-powered knowledge assistant application designed to help employees quickly search, retrieve, and interact with company documents and internal resources.
features: Streaming AI responses using Server-Sent Events (SSE)
Optimized chat state management using Cubit to handle streaming updates, loading states, and error
Built reusable chat UI components with markdown rendering and dynamic message updates
Optimized incremental markdown rendering to prevent unnecessary rebuilds and eliminate UI jank during streaming.

projects.title: Viet Nam Dieu Su
projects.description: An augmented reality app that allows users to explore Vietnam’s historical monuments in their original forms and understand key events through immersive AR experiences.
features: AI-powered chatbot for history and cultural Q&A
